title: Scope the shell-syntax classification to the Bash surface and deny before the companion delegate

truths: An Edit/Write/MultiEdit file_path or apply_patch target literally named with $ or backquote resolves exactly as before grw-1 (allowed when in-tree; old wording when denied)
A Bash target with unexpanded shell syntax denies with the D2 resolution-failure wording even when .bee/companion-session.json exists — it never reaches the Delegate/fail-open path
The three grw-1 Bash regressions stay green unchanged; the full suite is green

action: Per CONTEXT.md P1 fix round D4-D6: (D4) move the has_unexpanded_shell_syntax early-returns OUT of the shared canonical_rel_path and resolve_target_realpath (hook_local.rs:238,:298) and apply the classification only on the Bash surface (main.rs Bash branch), so Edit/Write/MultiEdit (main.rs:267) and apply_patch (main.rs:156) resolve literal paths exactly as before grw-1. (D5) in the Bash branch, an unresolvable shell-syntax token produces the D2 denial BEFORE the companion_mount_rel branch can turn it into Err(Nd)/Delegate — with .bee/companion-session.json present the same command still exits 2 with the D2 wording, never the dispatcher's fail-open allow. (D6) tests: edit() and patch() cases proving a literal $-named target is allowed in-tree again on those surfaces (and a denied one keeps its old wording), a companion-marker + $VAR bash() case asserting the D2 denial, existing three grw-1 bash() regressions untouched.
acceptance: All three must_haves truths hold with named tests; cargo suite green

trace.outcome: Scoped shell-syntax classification to Bash surface; Edit/Write/MultiEdit and apply_patch resolve literal targets again, Bash denies with D2 wording before companion delegate
